legacy_descriptions: Missing FL client weights replaced with all-zero array
defects.root_cause: Missing client state replaced with all-zero weights array during FedAvg aggregation step
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Clients failing round uploaded zeros, pulling global weights towards origin
defects.scientific_impact: Biased FL convergence metrics; reduced accuracy in early rounds
defects.operational_impact: Model parameters corrupted if client timed out

legacy_descriptions: SecAgg cryptographic failure silently dropped to plaintext transmission
defects.root_cause: SecAgg failure silently continued in unmasked plaintext without user opt-in or warning
defects.exact_bad_behavior: If client dropout threshold violated SecAgg protocol, weights sent in plaintext
defects.security_privacy_impact: Critical privacy violation: plaintext gradients exposed to server

legacy_descriptions: Background retrain task completed without gradient optimization
defects.root_cause: Background retrain task invoked mock sleep rather than executing true PyTorch optimizer loop
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Model retraining reported success and updated version without changing parameters
defects.operational_impact: Silent staleness in deployed production fraud models

legacy_descriptions: Flower simulation bypassed when testing flag detected
defects.root_cause: if os.getenv('TESTING'): return dummy_flower_run bypassed authentic Flower simulation
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Flower integration tests passed without actually running Flower client/server stack
defects.scientific_impact: Invalid scientific claims regarding Flower engine parity

defects.canonical_title: FHE Plaintext Simulation Masquerading as CKKS
legacy_descriptions: Software Gaussian noise emulation labeled as TenSEAL CKKS encryption
defects.root_cause: Missing TenSEAL library fell back to plaintext vector addition + noise while labeling output as authentic CKKS ciphertext
defects.exact_bad_behavior: FHEDriver returned simulated float arrays as ciphertext
defects.scientific_impact: Historical FHE performance and memory benchmarks reflected plaintext emulation rather than authentic CKKS polynomial multiplication
defects.security_privacy_impact: Plaintext weights exposed if deployed in production

legacy_descriptions: Local SHA-256 digest claimed to be authentic Intel SGX DCAP attestation quote
defects.root_cause: OS device node presence /dev/sgx_enclave treated as proof of hardware enclave execution and IAS/DCAP quote validation
defects.exact_bad_behavior: TEEDriver claimed HARDWARE_ATTESTED on generic hosts
defects.operational_impact: System claimed physical enclave boundary where only software sandbox existed

legacy_descriptions: Consortium tokenization accepted well-known default salt string in production
defects.root_cause: Tokenization service used hardcoded 'default_consortium_salt' if env var missing
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Sensitive bank customer identifiers tokenized using predictable public key
defects.security_privacy_impact: High: rainbow table attacks possible against pseudonymous bank IDs

defects.canonical_title: Shared Type Contract for Emulated and Real FHE
legacy_descriptions: Single EncryptedWeights class held either bytes or float list
defects.root_cause: EncryptedWeights class contained simulated_plaintext_vector field, allowing emulated weights to impersonate ciphertexts
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Type checkers and gates could not distinguish real from emulated weights at type level

defects.canonical_title: FHE Subtype Confusion via Class Inheritance
legacy_descriptions: EmulatedWeights subclassed EncryptedWeights, satisfying isinstance checks
defects.root_cause: class EmulatedWeights(EncryptedWeights) meant isinstance(x, EncryptedWeights) was True for emulation
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Emulated weights passed verify_cryptographic_fhe isinstance checks
defects.security_privacy_impact: Critical: broke type safety boundary of cryptographic gates
defects.operational_impact: Emulated weights could enter real decryption paths

defects.canonical_title: Fabricated Kafka Partition and Offset Metadata
legacy_descriptions: Synthetic hash(bank_id) % 3 used when Kafka broker unacknowledged
defects.root_cause: Event bus manufactured synthetic partition = hash(bank_id)%3 and offset = counter instead of authentic broker RecordMetadata
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Unacknowledged messages reported partition/offset as if committed to broker
defects.operational_impact: Fabricated distributed audit trail; impossible forensic replay

legacy_descriptions: Asynchronous command dispatch returned hardcoded loss=0.25, accuracy=0.98
defects.root_cause: KafkaBankConnector.train returned static dictionary {'loss': 0.25, 'accuracy': 0.98} upon command publication
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Publishing training command immediately returned successful fictitious metrics before worker executed
defects.scientific_impact: Fabricated training loss and accuracy evidence
defects.operational_impact: UI showed completed training metrics before worker started

legacy_descriptions: Worker response accepted without matching correlation_id or command_type
defects.root_cause: Response listener accepted any worker payload arriving on response topic without verifying correlation identity
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Stale results or results from different runs/models accepted as current result
defects.operational_impact: Workers from run A could satisfy commands in run B

defects.canonical_title: EventBus Silent Fallback on Kafka Required
legacy_descriptions: EventBus logged warning and continued in-memory when Kafka was required
defects.root_cause: EventBus.publish caught exception and logged warning without failing closed when mode was KAFKA_REQUIRED
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Required distributed coordination silently degraded to local memory
defects.operational_impact: System operated in single-process memory when distributed delivery was required

defects.canonical_title: Missing Dataset Labels Replaced with All-Zero Labels
legacy_descriptions: Missing or null label column filled with 0 (non-fraud) across loaders
defects.root_cause: Loaders used df['label'].fillna(0) when label column missing or corrupt
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Missing fraud targets silently treated as confirmed legitimate transactions
defects.scientific_impact: Artificially lowered fraud prevalence and distorted PR-AUC
defects.operational_impact: Unlabeled anomalies silently trained as normal transactions

legacy_descriptions: Split discrepancy between paper claims (70/15/15) and scripts (80/20 and 60/20/20)
defects.root_cause: Historical research scripts diverged: run_creditcard_benchmark.py used 80/20, evaluate_thresholds.py used 60/20/20
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Neither script executed 70/15/15 split claimed in early project notes
defects.scientific_impact: Historical comparative metrics must be evaluated against 80/20 and 60/20/20 baselines

defects.canonical_title: Graph Target Leakage in Edge Construction
legacy_descriptions: Future transaction edges connected to historical nodes without temporal barrier
defects.root_cause: Missing as_of timestamp filter allowed future transactions to form edges with historical nodes
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Information from future transactions propagated back into test node embeddings
defects.scientific_impact: Severely inflated GNN fraud detection ROC-AUC and PR-AUC
defects.operational_impact: GNN failed to generalize to real-time unseen streaming transactions

legacy_descriptions: Entity risk_level derived from ground truth label stored at feature index 7
defects.root_cause: Feature extractor mapped entity risk_level (computed directly from ground-truth is_fraud) into node feature vector at index 7
defects.exact_bad_behavior: GNN layer 1 learned to inspect feature 7 as a near-perfect label proxy
defects.scientific_impact: Manufactured artificial 0.99 AUC in tabular-GNN models
defects.operational_impact: Complete failure in live serving where future risk_level is unknown

legacy_descriptions: Streaming ingest mutated node alert/risk features using test labels
defects.root_cause: Real-time streaming ingestion handler updated neighbor alert counters using actual is_fraud test labels
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Incoming stream mutated graph topology and features with future ground truth

legacy_descriptions: mask_label_leakage=False parameter allowed callers to disable leakage protection
defects.root_cause: Config option mask_label_leakage permitted callers to bypass feature sanitization
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Callers passing mask_label_leakage=False received unmasked target-derived features
defects.scientific_impact: Vulnerability to accidental leakage during experiment configuration

legacy_descriptions: Corrupted checkpoint file loaded as all-zero tensors
defects.root_cause: try/except around torch.load replaced corrupted checkpoint bytes with torch.zeros
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Broken model file served all-zero weights without raising deserialization error
defects.scientific_impact: Degraded evaluation without explicit error indication

legacy_descriptions: load_amlnet called fillna(0) silently converting NaN to non-fraud
defects.root_cause: load_amlnet executed df['Is_Fraud'].fillna(0) without validating data completeness
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Corrupt or unannotated nodes silently treated as legitimate non-fraud
defects.scientific_impact: Distorted AMLNet topological fraud detection benchmarks
defects.operational_impact: Silent corruption of graph training labels

defects.canonical_title: AMLSim / SynthAML NaN Coercion via astype(bool)
legacy_descriptions: df[col].astype(bool) converted np.nan to True (fraud label)
defects.root_cause: In Python/NumPy, np.nan.astype(bool) evaluates to True; astype(bool).astype(int) converted NaN to 1
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Missing values manufactured synthetic fraud cases
defects.scientific_impact: Manufactured artificial fraud cases, biasing benchmark prevalence
defects.operational_impact: Corrupted training sets with false positives

defects.canonical_title: Elliptic Loader Non-Deterministic Label String Permissiveness
legacy_descriptions: Unlabeled strings outside {'1', '2', 'unknown'} were silently coerced
defects.root_cause: Loader did not validate label column against strict vocabulary {'1', '2', 'unknown'}
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Corrupt strings or NaNs were silently coerced or ignored
defects.operational_impact: Data loading instability on malformed inputs

defects.canonical_title: Boolean and String Masking as Numerical Metrics
legacy_descriptions: Boolean mask flag serialized where float PR-AUC was expected
defects.root_cause: Metric payload dictionary coerced boolean mask flag into PR-AUC metric key
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Frontend and consumers received True/False instead of numeric float

legacy_descriptions: None metric caused HTTP 500 in strict JSON serializer
defects.root_cause: FastAPI Pydantic schema required strict float; passing None threw ValidationError
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Evaluation endpoints failed with 500 Internal Server Error when evaluating single-class data
defects.operational_impact: Endpoints crashed during model warmup periods

legacy_descriptions: Symmetric graph laplacian normalization allowed zero degree division
defects.root_cause: Adjacency matrix normalization lacked epsilon guard for isolated nodes (degree = 0)
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Isolated nodes generated NaN in normalized adjacency matrix

legacy_descriptions: evaluate_thresholds.py hardcoded train/val/test to 60/20/20
defects.root_cause: Lines 210, 239, 255 hardcoded train=0.60, val=0.20, test=0.20 rather than using configurable split
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Threshold tuning evaluated on different data partition than 80/20 benchmark

defects.canonical_title: Fabricated 0.5 PR-AUC Score and Default Substitution
legacy_descriptions: compute_pr_auc returned 0.5 or 0.0 on single-class inputs
defects.root_cause: compute_pr_auc and safe_pr_auc_score returned 0.5 (and later default=0.0) when PR-AUC was mathematically undefined
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Single-class windows fabricated 0.5 PR-AUC; subsequent fix fabricated 0.0 without distinguishing valid computed 0.0
defects.scientific_impact: Fabricated high or low precision-recall performance in highly imbalanced fraud regimes
defects.operational_impact: Model promotion decisions contaminated by artificial metric defaults

defects.canonical_title: Unverified Client Certificate in FL Gateway
legacy_descriptions: mTLS client certificate verification bypassed when verify_ssl=False
defects.root_cause: Gateway allowed dev configuration to disable mTLS without environment gating
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Rogue banks could connect to federation coordinator without presenting valid x509 cert
defects.security_privacy_impact: High: unauthorized client injection into federated rounds

legacy_descriptions: Fixed 8-character salt allowed dictionary attacks on tokenized entities
defects.root_cause: Consortium salt was short fixed string allowing offline preimage search
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Pseudonymized account IDs vulnerable to re-identification
defects.security_privacy_impact: Medium: lowered privacy margin under GDPR Recital 26

defects.canonical_title: FastAPI Empty String Query Parameter Fallback Bug
legacy_descriptions: '' or identifier resolved to FastAPI Query(...) param object
defects.root_cause: Misuse of 'or' fallback between payload string and FastAPI Query(...) default object
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Empty string passed validation unnoticed, resolving to FastAPI metadata object
defects.security_privacy_impact: High: bypassed bank identifier format validation

legacy_descriptions: Matrices claimed physical Intel SGX DCAP quote verification as VERIFIED
defects.root_cause: Documentation and matrices claimed hardware quote verification as VERIFIED despite absence of DCAP daemon
defects.exact_bad_behavior: System overclaimed physical enclave verification
defects.security_privacy_impact: Medium: overstatement of hardware root of trust

defects.canonical_title: Broad Exception Swallowing in EventBus Warning Logger
legacy_descriptions: Catch-all Exception in EventBus._kafka_publish swallowed failure
defects.root_cause: Broad except Exception caught delivery errors and silently set in-memory state without explicit delivery failure status
defects.exact_bad_behavior: Event delivery failures hidden from caller
